module benchmark/solution

import std/net (httpRequest)

import std/io (println)

export func main() -> () ! {IO, Net} {
  let headers = [{ name: "X-Test-Header", value: "value123" }, { name: "Content-Type", value: "application/json" }]
  let body = "{\"message\":\"Hello from AILANG\",\"count\":42}"
  match httpRequest("POST", "{{MOCK_HTTP_URL}}", headers, body) {
    Ok(resp) => println(show(resp.status)),
    Err(_) => ()
  }
}
